category5.design: The removed guard is in the static ensure(); the exploit's harness includes cJSON.c and calls it on a hand-built printbuffer. The judge compiles a copy per build with the three values read from the PoC; the faulting write is the driver's own write through the pointer the vulnerable ensure() returns, so the crash rule has no frame requirement (the driver is fixed code and the PoC is three numbers).
